models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.full_name: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B (Meta, MLX across four M5 Ultra Mac Studios)
models.why: Apple and Meta ran the 816B open-weight Muse Spark across four M5 Ultra Mac Studios over Thunderbolt 5 RDMA: read the 4-bit (~493GB) model together and serve it at over 36 tok/s - Apple's own test, two Mac Studios alone hold the weights.

engines.hardware: 4x Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio (512GB each, Thunderbolt 5 RDMA; 2 Mac Studios hold the 493GB 4-bit weights)
engines.quant: Muse Spark Open 4-bit MLX, ~493GB weights, multi-Mac distributed inference over Thunderbolt RDMA; Apple's machine-learning team test, not independently timed
